title: What the Narwhal tastes

is_this_you.pressure: Pushed, you dive, and stay down past the point anyone thinks is safe. You surface with the answer already finished.
is_this_you.love: One slow touch from you settles more than an hour of talk. You would rather rub an old argument clean than win it.
is_this_you.cost: People praise the spiral and never ask what it feels. Some winters that costs you.

opener.text: Inuit in Greenland and on Baffin Island tell how the first narwhal came to be [s10]. A cruel mother starved her blind son [s10]. When his sight came back, he tied her to the harpoon line on a white whale [s10]. Dragged under, she twisted her hair into a horn and became the narwhal [s10]. Knud Rasmussen heard it at Cape York, and in the version Franz Boas heard on Baffin Island she is a stepmother [s10]. That story belongs to the people who tell it. Yours starts farther out, under the pack ice, with a Pisces born in a year of the Ox.

howto: Three parts. Go down into whichever one pulls.

tabs.label: The tusk
tabs.intro: Earth on the sea floor. Water over everything.

rows.text: Pisces is mutable Water, the twelfth sign, ruled by Jupiter and in modern astrology by Neptune [s1]. It is tender and selective, and slow to change a feeling once it settles [s1] [s2]. The Ox is yin Earth, patient and stubborn, happier alone than in a crowd [s3] [s4]. In you the Ox gives the Pisces flood its banks.

The tusk is a left upper canine that spirals as it grows, and it can reach three metres [s5] [s6]. It carries millions of nerve connections [s5] [s8]. In a 2014 field test, a narwhal's heart rate changed when salt water of a different strength washed over it [s7]. Strangers see a lance. Your sharpest feature is the one doing the listening.

Narwhals routinely dive past 800 metres, and many winter dives reach about 1,500 [s5] [s9]. Your best thinking happens at that depth. The Ox in you sees no reason to come up and report until the work is done.

Greenlanders have a word, savssat, for Arctic animals crowding at the last holes in freezing sea ice [s5]. After entrapments in 1914 and 1915, about 1,000 dead narwhals were found, mostly in Disko Bay [s5]. Hold a true word too long and the hole freezes. Bring up the half-finished thought while there is still open water.
Polar science, sonar and sound design all reward a sense that works in the dark. Watch the loyalty that keeps you in an underpaid post.

tabs.label: Who surfaces with you
tabs.intro: Three who rise on your schedule. A fourth who swims against you.
tabs.love_lead: In love you are slow, then fixed, and the Ox dislikes churn [s4]. You need someone who reads a long silence as presence. Three old Chinese pairings answer you.

easy.why: The Chambered Nautilus (Cancer, Snake year) stands in your trine of Ox, Snake and Rooster, and Cancer is Water like you [s3] [s1].
The Slow Loris (Scorpio, Snake year) is trine kin too, and Scorpio completes the three Water signs [s3] [s1].
The Coconut Crab (Cancer, Rat year) is your secret friend, since the Rat is the Ox's hidden ally, and it swims in your element [s3] [s1].

hard.why: The hard one is the Ghost Pipefish (Pisces, Goat year): alike in the water, but the Goat is the Ox's clash [s3].

story.text: Between 1662 and 1671 Bendix Grodtschilling built Denmark's coronation chair from narwhal tusk, said to be unicorn horn [s11]. It was modelled on Solomon's throne, and kings were anointed on it from 1671 to 1840 [s11].

closing: Kings sat on what you carry and called it magic. Keep the crown. It was always for listening.
